# GEO report: Millstone Bakery **New to GEO?** GEO (generative engine optimization) means making your site easy for search engines and AI tools to find, read and quote. This report checks the technical basics. ## Code score: 100/100, Strong Confidence: High (checked 23 of 23 points). How it's calculated: low = 23 ÷ 23 × 100 = 100. High = (23 + 0) ÷ 23 × 100 = 100. Everything I could check from the code is in order. The site is four static HTML pages. Nothing is decided at runtime, so no rule was left as "can't tell". Rules marked "live only" and the bot-protection question are listed below. ## Live check - **Not run.** To add it, give me your site's URL. ## Do these first Nothing in the code needs fixing. The biggest open question is whether a CDN or firewall lets real crawlers through. Code can't show that. ### 1. Confirm real crawlers get through (optional) - **Why it matters:** the files allow search crawlers, but bot protection in front of the site could still block them. - **Where:** `robots.txt:1-2` - **What the code says:** `User-agent: *` / `Allow: /` - **Size:** Small - **Score after this:** stays 100 whichever way it comes out. This only confirms the result. ## All results | Rule | What it checks | Code | Where | | --- | --- | --- | --- | | GEO-013 | robots.txt is valid and reachable | Clear | `robots.txt` is plain text with valid lines | | GEO-009 | Search crawlers are allowed | Clear | `robots.txt:1-3` allows `*` except `/members/`. GPTBot is blocked (`robots.txt:5-6`), which matches your "trainingCrawlers: block" policy, so it isn't counted | | GEO-014 | Listed and linked pages are indexable | Clear | 3 of 3 sampled routes have no noindex. `members/index.html:9` is noindex on purpose | | GEO-015 | One absolute canonical per page | Clear | 3 of 3 sampled routes (`index.html:8`, `breads.html:8`, `classes.html:8`) have one on `www.millstonebakery.example` | | GEO-003 | Content is in the server HTML | Clear | Static HTML with the text in `
` | | GEO-004 | JSON-LD is valid | Not applicable | No JSON-LD in the repo | | GEO-011 | Sitemap is valid and discoverable | Clear | `sitemap.xml` is valid, and `robots.txt:8` points to it | | GEO-012 | Title, description and html lang | Clear | All 3 sampled routes have all three, each unique | | GEO-016 | Pages reachable via real links | Clear | `` nav on every page, e.g. `index.html:12` | | GEO-017 | No snippet blocks against AI-search policy | Clear | Only the element-level `data-nosnippet` at `breads.html:16`, which is a deliberate choice | | GEO-002 | Basic accessibility | Clear | I read all pages. The one `` has alt (`index.html:16`), and all links have text | | GEO-101 | Mobile app association files | Not applicable | No app is declared | | GEO-010 | llms.txt (information only) | Not applicable | Not present, and not scored | | GEO-102 | App structured data (information only) | Not applicable | Not scored | ## Other problems found None found. ## Worth considering - **Add LocalBusiness/Bakery JSON-LD:** `index.html:6`: `Millstone Bakery, sourdough in York`. The name and town are on the page, but nothing machine-readable states them. Add the address, opening hours and phone number to the home page and label them in JSON-LD. The address, hours and phone are not in the repo, so you'd need to supply them. - **List the breads:** `breads.html:15`: `Over twenty loaves through the week, including our seeded rye and the country white.` The page promises over twenty loaves but names two. List each loaf with a short description. A separate page per loaf might help it be found for that loaf. - **Say what the classes are:** `classes.html:15`: `Book early, because places go quickly.` There are no dates, price, length or booking link. Add them as text. - **Explain how to pre-order:** `index.html:15`: `Pre-order for weekend collection.` Nothing says how. Add a link or the steps. - **Add `` to the sitemap:** `sitemap.xml:3-5`. The entries have no last-modified dates. Add them. - **Add social tags:** `index.html:3-8` has no `og:title`, `og:description` or `og:image`. Add them so links shared on social sites show properly. - **Link the pages to each other:** `breads.html:15` and `classes.html:15` have no onward links in the body text. For example, link the classes page to the breads page. - **Check the members page setup:** `robots.txt:3` blocks `/members/`, so crawlers can't fetch the page and never see its `noindex` (`members/index.html:9`). This is fine for a private page. If you ever need it kept out of results, drop the Disallow line so the noindex can be read. ## Can't tell from code - **Live-only checks:** the real status codes, redirects, `X-Robots-Tag` headers and server-rendered link checks for GEO-003, 011, 014, 015, 016 and 002. They don't change the code results. A live scan with your URL would confirm them. - **Bot protection:** code can't show whether a CDN or firewall lets real crawlers through. Run `geopilot logs `, which checks real crawlers against their published addresses. ## Assumptions - You want AI search tools to find this site, as `geo.config.json` says. - The `.example` domain is a placeholder for your real one. - I read all 4 pages, so nothing was sampled. ## What to do next 1. Run the geopilot `fix` command to apply item 1. You'll see every change before anything is written. 2. Run the geopilot `explain` command with any rule id, such as `GEO-014`, to learn more. 3. For proof from a running site, ask for a live scan with its URL. Technical readiness only. GEO does not measure or predict citations, rankings, traffic or inclusion in any AI or search product.
